items.context: @BitcoinMagazine (4.490.300 seguidores): "JUST IN: The Bitcoin Fear & Greed Index is now at 12, 'extreme fear' 👀 Be greedy when others are fearful ✊" (con imagen). Post de ~37 min con 152 likes, 24 reposts, 42 respuestas y 19846 vistas, creciendo rápido.
items.suggested_text:
Worth remembering what that 12 actually measures: mostly how the market feels about the last few weeks of price, with recent volatility and momentum doing a lot of the work. Sentiment like this tends to lag the move that caused it, so extreme fear usually shows up after much of the damage is already done.

That's why I prefer pairing it with valuation rather than reading it alone. MVRV, where price sits against the 200-week average and the size of the drawdown from the high tell you whether the fear is landing on an expensive market or a cheap one. Those are very different setups, even with the same reading on the dial.

"Be greedy when others are fearful" sounds simple. The hard part is that extreme fear can stay extreme for weeks, and it rarely feels like the bottom while you're in it.
